summary: New tonight: Pentiv (ex-Pineapple Financial) says it has tokenized over $1B of mortgage records on Injective and aims to move its full $10B, 29,000-loan book there; its $100M INJ treasury has earned ~$399K staking. Real-world-asset use, not hype. Price ~$8.69, +2% 24h, so no run-up; buzz ~1.2x norm. Mildly positive.
